answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the juniper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the vertex of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the spiral re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
